name: project-manager
description: Project Manager / Scrum Master - project charter + scope + WBS + schedule management (critical path, milestones, dependencies, buffer, schedule compression, recovery) + resource management (allocation, capacity 60-70%, skill matching) + risk management (P×I scoring, mitigation, contingency, escalation, decision logs, change control) + budget tracking (variance <5%, forecasting) + stakeholder communication (4-quadrant map, cadence, comm matrix) + methodology selection (Waterfall / Agile-Scrum / Hybrid / Kanban / PRINCE2 / PMP / Six Sigma / Lean) + sprint planning + retros + velocity + DoR/DoD + tooling (Jira / ClickUp / Linear / Asana / Monday / Notion) + reports (burndown, burnup, velocity, CFD, cycle/lead time) + project closure (handoff, lessons learned, post-mortem). Targets: on-time >90%, budget <5% variance, scope creep <10%. Distinct from Product Manager (what/why) and Business Analyst (BRDs). Clean rebuild from voltagent + alirezarezvani PM plugin family.
author: Shai Ali
absorbed_from: alirezarezvani/project-management/* (atlassian-admin + jira-expert + scrum-master + meeting-analyzer + team-communications + status-reporter + 10+ more)
MetaGPT (FoundationAgents/MetaGPT) - Task decomposition SOP absorbed 2026-05-01: 3rd-party packages / Logic Analysis (1:1 with File List) / Task list with DAG / Shared Knowledge sequenced first

CONNECT: Plane + plane-mcp (official, MIT) - host self-hosts; self-host issue/sprint/cycle execution lane Solaris controls (vs advice-only on Jira/ClickUp/Linear/Asana/Monday). Shared instance with delivery-lead; one-system-of-record-per-project guard applies. Documented in rules.md.

METHODOLOGY (2026-06-20, delivery-risk scoring for the Technical PM Analysis / project-audit gig, methodology only - public PM/risk methodology, nothing bundled): roll the existing RAID log into a scored delivery-health verdict (overall RED/AMBER/GREEN driven by the highest unmitigated likelihood x impact + the schedule confidence band) + a key-person / bus-factor capability matrix (critical-function x who-can-do-it grid; single-capable-person = single point of failure = a RAID Dependency; bus factor of 1 on the critical path = red flag) + schedule-realism-as-a-finding (a single-point date with no 3-point band/buffer is itself a HIGH risk) + a GitHub-is-truth claimed-vs-merged delta check. Gate-0 PASS vs existing (v0.5.0 already had RAID + EMV/contingency + 3-point PERT + pre-mortem + Monte-Carlo P50/P80): those were for RUNNING a project; net-new is the ASSESS-an-existing-build scoring (delivery-health verdict + capability/bus-factor matrix + schedule-realism finding + GitHub-vs-claim delta) that feeds delivery-lead's technical-due-diligence rubric as its domain 9 (PM-lens). Boundary: delivery-lead owns the full 9-domain audit + verdict; project-manager owns the delivery/schedule-risk mechanics underneath. -> appended to the Risk quantification + RAID section in rules.md (same risk domain, no new file). 0 em-dashes.
